full_judgment: 3. The defendants contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the material statements made in the plaint of the suit, contending, inter-alia that the suit is barred by limitation. The original owner of the suit land left the country before 1965 and has been living in India permanently. In order to circumvent the Government from taking over possession of the above property as per provisions of President's Order No.98 of 1972, the aforesaid property was fraudulently shown to have been sold in auction. In fact, Miscellaneous Case No.1 of 1992 was started for treating the property as khas property of the Government and one Ashrafuddin illegally got his name mutated in the khatian in respect of the suit land.
